outgoing.name: 14th century
outgoing.excerpt: A subsequent Hindu revival included a large-scale campaign of desecration of Buddhist images, before Theravada Buddhism became established from the 14th century.

outgoing.name: 15th century
outgoing.excerpt: During the 15th century, nearly all of Angkor was abandoned after Siamese attacks, except Angkor Wat, which remained a shrine for Buddhist pilgrims.

outgoing.name: 19th century
outgoing.excerpt: The great city and temples remained largely cloaked by the forest until the late 19th century when French archaeologists began a long restoration process.

outgoing.name: Buddha
outgoing.excerpt: Temples were altered to display images of the Buddha, and Angkor Wat briefly became a Buddhist shrine.

outgoing.name: Hinduism
outgoing.excerpt: Construction of Angkor Thom coincided with a change from Hinduism to Mahayana Buddhism.
